title: Decision Table — The Presentation Share of Priced Charges, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Decision Table — The Presentation Share of Priced Charges, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

How much of the lateness charges read for the cycle a statement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan actually presents is the presentation share.

| The plan at the handling date | The presentation share |
|---|---|
| An arrangement stands in force on it | Nothing at all, the charges being carried to the close of that arrangement instead |
| No arrangement stands in force, and automatic payment is in force on it | This desk's held-over share of **50 percent** |
| Any other case | The whole of them, that is **100 percent** |

An arrangement in force governs whatever else holds: a plan running on an arrangement with automatic payment in force presents nothing of its lateness charges this cycle, those charges being carried to the close of the arrangement.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Where the lateness charges read for the cycle come to 80.00 USD:

- On a plan running on an arrangement: nothing is presented for priced charges this cycle.
- On a plan with no arrangement and automatic payment in force: 50 percent of 80.00 USD, that is 40.00 USD.
- On a plan with neither: 100 percent of 80.00 USD, that is 80.00 USD.
